name: Abubakar Sadiq Ismail
cooked:
b10c:

I think your timeouts for Onion and I2P might be off. I have about 11.5k reachable Tor nodes and 5.6k reachable I2P nodes in my data from earlier this week. In Logbook: Measuring the Bitcoin Network With Our Own Crawler @ifuensan made the observation that measuring Tor nodes is really dependent on how well your crawler is setup.

my crawler gave the whole handshake an 8 s budget including the Tor circuit build which was cutting off reachable onions mid-connect. I run a quick re-crawling the timed-out addresses with a longer connect timeout, a random sample recovered ~87% as genuine.

I will run it again on full sample and report.
